description: Regression contract coverage for Nowen Note sync, offline writes and restore. Tests are executed by scripts/data-consistency-contract.mjs and required by the workflow when protected paths change.

policies.title: 已同步的声明必须有服务端版本确认

checks.case: requires server revision advancement before a versioned write is considered synced
removes successful queued updates only after the server ACK

policies.title: 本地业务写入与 Outbox 变更应在持久化后可恢复

checks.case: 创建笔记进入 Outbox，且 upsert 顺序在其笔记本之后
修改笔记携带 OLD.version 作为 baseVersion
keeps edits queued without network traffic across reinitialization, then uploads them on enable

policies.title: 断网、服务端失败或停止调度不得静默丢弃待同步修改

checks.case: 服务端错误时条目保留在 Outbox，重试次数增长但不删除
断网时进入 offline，Outbox 原样保留
stop 只停调度，本地数据与 Outbox 一个字不删
captures an unexpected scheduled sync failure without advancing the cursor or dropping local changes

policies.title: 冲突必须保留本机意图和服务端版本，不能静默覆盖

checks.case: VERSION_CONFLICT 登记冲突台账并保留本地内容
远端变更不覆盖本地未推送的修改，改为登记冲突
keeps both local and server snapshots in a bounded conflict vault

policies.title: 同步游标与 ACK 必须晚于内容校验和本地应用

checks.case: Change Feed upsert 缺少 Snapshot payload 时不推进游标或 ACK
未知同步实体不能被跳过并推进游标或 ACK
does not apply, ACK, or advance the cursor for an unknown change-feed entity

policies.title: 跨账号跨服务端 Outbox 不得串用

checks.case: listPendingMutations 严格按 Profile 隔离
blocks cross-account outbox requests during session reconfiguration

policies.title: 删除必须以明确的删除操作或墓碑同步

checks.case: 删除笔记产生 delete mutation 且带 baseVersion
incremental feed returns committed updates and durable deletion tombstones
does not delete local notebooks or tags missing from a remote listing

policies.title: 不完整备份不可直接覆盖线上数据，失败要回滚

checks.case: attachment audit rejects local DB paths missing from full ZIP
post-replace verifier failure rolls live directory contents back
corrupt zip db.sqlite is rejected before touching current database or jwt secret

policies.title: Android Native 关闭同步后重启仍保留未发出修改

checks.case: keeps edits queued without network traffic across reinitialization, then uploads them on enable
handles /scopes HTTP 401 before per-scope processing without deleting local writes

policies.title: Web 离线队列失败和冲突均不得被误视为同步成功

checks.case: keeps normal server errors retryable
preserves a permanent client failure and its local payload instead of dropping it
preserves a stale offline edit as one pending conflict without issuing PUT

policies.title: 逐笔记同步收据以当前修改的版本/Mutation ACK 为依据

checks.case: requires exact local revision before acknowledging a note write
preserves pending queue and conflict priority over an older ACK
isolates receipt data across account and server scopes
requires a matching native mutation receipt instead of global sync time
keeps native pending and conflicts ahead of committed ACK
does not discard a newer queued edit after a stale in-flight HTTP 200
